key_insight: FlowPipe turns data-pipeline construction into conditional flow generation, using reward-aware trajectory learning and LLM-guided modulation to search more effectively over valid pipeline sequences.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to automate data preparation for machine learning, reducing manual pipeline design while improving solution quality and training efficiency.
method: Model pipeline synthesis as a conditional Generative Flow Network over a DAG of cleaning/feature operators.
Use Trajectory Balance to propagate terminal validation reward back to early decisions.
Inject LLM-derived dataset semantics via FiLM and add failure awareness to suppress invalid states.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on two benchmark suites with 74 real-world datasets, FlowPipe improved accuracy by 11.96% on average and converged 12.5x faster than SOTA baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of LLM-derived semantic priors and the correctness of reward evaluation, which may be costly or noisy in new datasets.
paper_title: FlowPipe: LLM-Enhanced Conditional Generative Flow Networks for Data Preparation Pipeline Construction
